steps.en: Deploy to Vercel with one click, or run the single Docker image
steps.zh: 一键部署 Vercel，或起单个 Docker 容器

steps.en: Pass your provider keys and an access password as env vars
steps.zh: 用环境变量喂入服务商 key 和访问密码

steps.en: Serves the chat UI; all conversations stay in your browser's localStorage
steps.zh: 提供聊天界面，对话全部存在你浏览器的本地存储

steps.en: Open the URL, unlock with a CODE password, pick a model and chat
steps.zh: 打开网址，用 CODE 解锁，挑模型开聊

steps.en: Streams answers from the provider you picked, rendering markdown, LaTeX, and code live
steps.zh: 从你选的服务商流式取回答案，实时渲染 markdown

value.en: Your own ChatGPT-style URL in minutes — keys stay yours, chats stay in the browser, one password keeps strangers out
value.zh: 几分钟得到自己的 ChatGPT 式网址：key 自持、历史本地、一道密码挡陌生人

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-28 (raw.githubusercontent.com/ChatGPTNextWeb/NextChat): one-click Vercel deploy; docker pull yidadaa/chatgpt-next-web; docker run -d -p 3000:3000 -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-xxxx -e CODE=your-password yidadaa/chatgpt-next-web; CODE is the page password, comma-separated; 'Privacy first, all data is stored locally in the browser'; streaming response; markdown LaTex mermaid code highlight
